swap.slippage-low: At {n}% the swap is canceled if the price moves even slightly. Your funds come back, minus the network fees.

swap.near-confirm-body: This is a valid NEAR account name, but addresses from other chains can look like one too, and NEAR does not refuse them. Confirm this is a NEAR account:
swap.near-small-body: NEAR doesn’t refund mistakes, like sending the wrong coin or using the wrong network, on swaps under $300. Check every detail before you continue.
swap.deposit-leave-note: If you leave, it stays at the top of Swap.
swap.deposit-already-paid: Already paid it? Paste the transaction hash and we will follow it.
swap.deposit-left-anyway: Did the ZEC leave this wallet after all? Paste its transaction hash so tracking can resume.

swap.qr-carries-amount: The QR has the address and the exact amount
swap.qr-carries-memo: The QR has the address, the amount and the memo

swap.memo-hint-evm: On this network the memo goes in the data field, not as a note.

swap.review-next-address: Next, Zingo gives you the address to pay from your other wallet.
swap.review-refund-new-address: To a new address in your wallet
swap.review-price-fixed: The price stays fixed while you review
swap.tracking-background: It keeps going if you leave. You’ll find it at the top of Swap and in History.
swap.not-detected-title: We haven’t detected your payment yet
swap.not-detected-body: Check that you sent exactly {amount} {coin} to the address of this swap.
swap.result-in-your-wallet: It is already in your wallet.
swap.result-shield-note-received: It’s in your transparent balance, not private yet.
swap.result-shield-note-refund: It’s in your transparent balance, not private yet.
swap.result-refunded-sell: The swap didn’t complete, so the ZEC came back to your wallet, minus the network fee.
swap.expired-why: No deposit was detected, so nothing moved
swap.expired-dont-send: Don’t send anything to that address anymore.
swap.expired-late-refund: If you pay to that address now, {provider} sends it back to your refund address ({address}).
swap.expired-toast: No {coin} deposit was detected. Nothing was sent.
swap.late-why: Your payment arrived after this swap closed, so it can’t be swapped
swap.late-note: {provider} sends it back to your refund address, minus the network fee. You don’t need to do anything.
swap.late-toast: Your {coin} arrived after this swap closed. It’s going back to your refund address.
swap.result-incomplete-line: Your payment arrived, but it’s not enough for this route. The provider sends it back to your refund address, or waits for the rest.
swap.result-paste-hash: Paste the transaction hash and Zingo tracks it.
swap.result-failed-sell: The deposit never left your wallet, so your ZEC is where it was.
swap.result-failed-buy: The provider rejected the payment. If you sent funds, they go back to your refund address.
swap.detail-remove-body: This removes the swap from your history. The transactions themselves stay on chain.
swap.detail-remove-unpaid: This swap has not been paid yet. Removing it only forgets it here: if you send the deposit later, this wallet will no longer track it.
swap.delete-expired-body: No deposit was detected, so no funds are involved. It only disappears from History and Your swaps.
swap.shield-note: It's in your transparent balance, not private yet.
swap.leg-hop-note-2: , your ZEC goes through this address in your wallet.
swap.leg-hop-note-3: needs the payment to come from here to know it is yours.
swap.leg-payment-note: address made only for this swap.
swap.leg-refund-note-memo: sent the ZEC back to the same address the payment came from.
swap.leg-refund-note: Your ZEC came back to an address in your wallet.
swap.leg-received-note: The address in your wallet where the swap's ZEC arrived.
swap.tx-dont-send: Don't send more ZEC to this address.
swap.msg-busy: The swap service is busy right now. Try again in a minute.
swap.msg-busy-resume: The swap service is busy right now. Quotes resume in {time}.
swap.msg-over-limit: That amount is over the limit for a single swap. Try a smaller amount.
swap.msg-no-route: No route is available for this swap right now.
swap.msg-below-every-minimum: That amount is below the minimum every provider accepts for this pair.
swap.msg-too-small: That amount is too small. The smallest amount that routes right now is about {amount}.
swap.msg-cannot-price: {who} could not price this swap just now. Refresh the quote and try again, or take another route.
swap.msg-no-source-route: {who} has no route out of the asset you are selling just now. Take another route, or try again later.
swap.msg-no-liquidity: {who} does not have the liquidity for this swap right now. Try a smaller amount, or another route.
swap.msg-quote-expired: That quote is no longer good. Refresh it and start the swap again.
swap.msg-provider-busy: {who} is refusing requests for the moment. Try again in a minute.
swap.msg-wallet-cannot: This wallet cannot swap through this provider yet.
swap.msg-refusal-rate-limited: The provider is refusing requests for the moment. The next quote may reach it.
swap.msg-refusal-estimate: Could not price this swap right now. It may be back on the next quote.
swap.msg-refusal-liquidity: Not enough liquidity for this swap right now.
swap.msg-below-provider-minimum: The amount is below this provider's minimum.
swap.msg-needs-usd: Needs at least {amount} for this swap right now.
swap.msg-not-available: Not available for this swap right now.
swap.over-balance: That’s more than you can swap. Tap Available to swap the most you can.
swap.provider-pending: Shows once you enter an amount
swap.address-zcash: That’s a Zcash address. Swap sends to another coin.
swap.nym-wait: Your ZEC travels the NYM mixnet. Waiting for it.
swap.tip-privacy: The swap goes through an outside service, so that service sees your IP address, the amount and the addresses. Your funds in Zingo stay private.
swap.tip-derived: Zingo creates a new transparent address for every swap, so no one can link one swap to another. You can shield the ZEC once it arrives.
swap.tip-refund: If the swap can’t be completed, the funds come back to this address on their own.
swap.tip-slip: How much the price can move while the swap travels. If it moves more, the swap is refunded. Lower protects your amount; higher fails less often.
swap.tip-min: The price can move while the swap travels. You never get less than this: if it can’t be met, your ZEC comes back.
swap.tip-fees: What the network and the exchange service charge. It’s already taken out of what you get.
swap.tip-net: With NEAR it’s one transaction. With Maya or THORChain it’s two: first the ZEC leaves your private balance, then it pays with the memo.
swap.tip-exact: The service looks for this exact amount to recognize your payment. A different amount can take longer or come back.
swap.routes-sub: Best price first. Prices refresh every 20 seconds.
swap.review-nym-note: Your ZEC leaves your wallet through the NYM mixnet, so the provider can’t see where it came from.
swap.qr-no-memo: This payment needs a memo and the QR can’t carry it. Copy the address, the amount and the memo by hand.
swap.exact-amount-btc: Make sure your wallet doesn’t take the fee out of it.
swap.memo-hint-btc: On Bitcoin the memo goes as an OP_RETURN. If your wallet can’t do that, go back and choose NEAR.
swap.result-refunded-buy: The swap didn’t complete, so the {coin} went back to your refund address, minus the network fee.
swap.no-route-now: No route is available for this swap right now.

meetironwood.title: Meet Ironwood
meetironwood.step1-body-1: **Ironwood** is a new, more private home for your Zcash. Its privacy is mathematically proven to work.
meetironwood.step1-body-2: After the **NU6.3** upgrade, the old **Orchard** pool stops taking in new funds, and new payments go to Ironwood.
meetironwood.option1-body: Keep using your wallet as usual. Each transaction will reveal its amount.
meetironwood.option2-body: A quick internal transaction that moves everything to Ironwood at once. Your amounts are revealed.

migrationstrategy.title: Migration Strategy
migrationstrategy.intro: Since this is a cross-pool transfer, amounts will be revealed. Choose the privacy level of the migration.
migrationstrategy.none-body: Keep your funds where they are for now. You can start migrating later from the home screen.
migrationstrategy.now-body: One transfer, done in minutes. Your full balance of **{amount}** becomes publicly visible on-chain, and your IP will be associated with it unless you use ##NYM##.
migrationstrategy.nym-gate-body: We recommend using the NYM mixnet to avoid correlation between your IP and your balance.

migrationsending.title: Sending transactions
migrationsending.subtitle: Sending your Orchard notes to the Ironwood pool. Keep the app open until every transaction is sent.
migrationsending.hint: This can take a moment. Please keep the app open.

migrationtransactions.nothing-body: Your Orchard pool has no funds worth migrating right now.
migrationtransactions.pending-body: The wallet has Orchard funds, but they are not spendable now. Wait for more blocks. Then try again.

seedbackup.info-title: A few important things to know
seedbackup.info-sub: Read this carefully before you continue
seedbackup.info-access: This phrase gives full access to your wallet and your funds
seedbackup.info-paper: Write it down on paper and keep it somewhere safe
seedbackup.info-private: View it in private and never share it
seedbackup.keychain-ios: Also saved encrypted in the iOS Keychain.
seedbackup.keychain-android: Also saved encrypted in the Android Keystore.
seedbackup.load-error: The seed phrase could not be read. Try again.
seedbackup.words-sub: Write the 24 words in order and the birthday number. You'll confirm a few of them at the end
seedbackup.copied-toast: Copied words and birthday. Clipboard clears in 60 s
seedbackup.paper: I wrote it down on paper and stored it somewhere safe.
seedbackup.check-first: Check the box once you've written it down
seedbackup.confirm-sub: Type the word that goes in each position
seedbackup.word-hint: Find it on your paper and type it
seedbackup.word-wrong: That's not word #{n}. Check your paper and try again.
seedbackup.done-body: You can now restore this wallet on any device with your 24 words and birthday.
seedbackup.shot-body: Anyone who gets into your photos gets into your wallet. Write the words down on paper.
seedbackup.birthday-tip-title: The block your wallet was created in.
seedbackup.birthday-tip-body: Zingo starts scanning from here instead of from the beginning, so it syncs much faster.

walletseed.sub-change-vo: Before accessing another wallet, carefully save this wallet's viewing key and birthday. You'll need them to get back to it.
walletseed.change-warning-vo: If you change to another wallet, you will no longer have access to this wallet without the viewing key.
walletseed.no-sub: Write it down to protect your funds
walletseed.vk-tip-title: Lets someone see this wallet's activity.
walletseed.vk-tip-body: It can't spend your funds. Only share it with people or services you trust.
walletseed.sub-change: Before accessing another wallet, carefully save this wallet's seed phrase, birthday and viewing key. You'll need them to get back to it.
walletseed.sub-server: Before changing the server, carefully save this wallet's seed phrase, birthday and viewing key. You'll need them to get back to it.

viewingkey.switch-sub: Before switching to {net}, carefully save this wallet's viewing key. You'll need it to get back to it.
viewingkey.switch-warning: If you change to a server on another network, you will no longer have access to this wallet without the viewing key.
viewingkey.title: Your viewing key
viewingkey.sub: Anyone with this key can see this wallet's balance and history. It can't spend funds.
viewingkey.label: Unified viewing key
viewingkey.read: Read-only: shows the balance, history and addresses
viewingkey.spend: Can't send, swap or spend funds
viewingkey.share: Share it only with people you trust. They'll see all your activity

viewonly.title: View-only wallet
viewonly.body: You can see the balance and history and receive funds. Spending isn't possible with a viewing key.

sync.title: Sync
sync.both-at: Wallet and server are both at block {tip}
sync.tip-text: Zingo goes through the blockchain again from your wallet birthday. Use it if something looks wrong or is missing.
sync.sheet-sub: Zingo fetches every transaction again and rebuilds your shielded wallet.
sync.sheet-start: Starts at block {n}, your wallet birthday
sync.sheet-time: Takes a few minutes. You can keep using Zingo while it runs
sync.sheet-incomplete: Balance and history can look incomplete until it finishes

errorboundary.title: Something went wrong
errorboundary.message: An unexpected error occurred. Please restart the app.
